channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: RBI Stability Report 2025: Economy Stays Strong As Bad Loans Hit Record Lows Amid Rising Fintech Risks
item.description: India's economy remains resilient with record-low bad loans, but RBI warns of rising unsecured debt and fintech risks.

item.title: Chinese Mother Jailed For Accidentally Killing Daughter During Ritual “Exorcism” In Shenzhen
item.description: A Chinese mother was sentenced for accidentally killing her daughter during a ritual intended to expel demons.

item.title: ‘Speed Comes From Proximity, Not Pressure’: Zomato CEO Addresses Safety Fears Over 10-Minute Deliveries
item.description: Zomato’s CEO says quick deliveries rely on nearby restaurants, not rushed riders, amid growing concerns over safety, penalties, and gig worker protections.

item.title: People of Purpose: From Grassroots to Runa Pathak’s Impact Leadership at Jubilant FoodWorks Ltd
item.description: From childhood grassroots volunteering to heading Jubilant FoodWorks' award-winning CSR initiatives, Runa Pathak bridges empathy, policy, and business for sustainable impact on 14,000+ farmers and youth.

item.title: Lucknow Police Ring in New Year with Patriotic Film Screening for Underprivileged Children Inspiring Kindness
item.description: Hazratganj Police screened Ikkis for 140 underprivileged kids at Novelty Cinema on New Year's Day.

item.title: Explosions Over Caracas as Trump Claims Capture of Venezuela’s President in Major US Military Strike
item.description: A claimed US military operation in Venezuela sparks global alarm as President Trump announces Nicolás Maduro’s capture, while opposition refuting the claims.

item.title: India Bans High-Dose Nimesulide Above 100 mg to Curb Liver Damage Risks
item.description: India has banned oral Nimesulide doses above 100 mg, ordering recalls and urging patients to switch to safer alternatives due to serious liver injury risks.

item.title: Indore Water Crisis: MP CM Transfers Municipal Commissioner, Suspends Two Senior Officials
item.description: After multiple deaths exposed months of administrative neglect, the Madhya Pradesh government cracked down on senior Indore officials over contaminated drinking water.

item.title: Logical Take: Indian Football’s Crisis Isn’t About Talent but About a Systemic Failure Hurting Players
item.description: Indian football’s struggles stem not from lack of talent, but from systemic governance, financial instability, and short-term planning failures.

item.title: ‘Brutal Mob Assault’: Family Relives Terror as Third Hindu Man Burned Alive in Bangladesh, Demands Justice
item.description: Peaceful Hindu businessman's brutal mob attack and death in Shariatpur highlights escalating minority violence in Bangladesh.
